title: PMA Application Letter
note: Organization-agnostic. Every {{token}} is supplied by the tenant profile or the case. No tenant data is embedded here.
source: F-851-45 Rev C — letter templates, pages 2-5. Variant selected by item 1.A (Source x Count).

variantSelector.note: F-851-45 item 1.A: Single source -> page 2 (TC Holder) or page 3 (STC); Multiple source -> page 4 (TC Holder) or page 5 (STC).

skeleton.text: {{tenant.legalName}} is submitting an application for Parts Manufacturing Approval (PMA) for {{case.systemName}}. We request your review of the enclosed data being submitted in support of this application. The {{case.systemShortName}} consists of the components listed in the unnumbered PMA Supplement and can be installed in {{case.modelEligibility}}, {{case.airworthinessPart}} aircraft.

The system components will be manufactured at {{tenant.legalName}}, {{tenant.manufacturingAddress}}. The items listed in the unnumbered PMA Supplement will be manufactured in accordance with our FAA approved quality system.
We appreciate your effort in support of this request.

TC_HOLDER__SINGLE.paragraph_2_basis: Approval is requested based on identicality to the approved design data of TC {{case.tcNumber}} and are evidenced by the FAA PMA Supporting Data Letters, reference {{case.supportingDataLetterRef}}, dated {{case.supportingDataLetterDate}} under 14 CFR 21.303.
enclosures: Copy {{case.tcHolderShort}} Supporting data for PMA Letter.

STC__SINGLE.paragraph_2_basis: Approval is requested based on identicality to the approved design data of STC {{case.stcNumber}} and is evidenced by the STC Authorizations under 14 CFR 21.303(a)(4).

TC_HOLDER__MULTIPLE.paragraph_2_basis: Approval is requested based on identicality to the approved design data of TCs {{case.tcNumberList}} and are evidenced by the Supporting Data for PMA Letters dated {{case.supportingDataLetterDates}} under 14 CFR 21.303.
enclosures: Copy {{case.tcHolderShort}} Supporting data for PMA Letters

STC__MULTIPLE.paragraph_1_override: {{tenant.legalName}} is submitting an application for Parts Manufacturing Approval (PMA) for the {{tenant.systemFamilyName}} as showed on the below table. We request your review of the enclosed data being submitted in support of this application. The {{case.systemShortName}} consists of the components listed in the unnumbered PMA Supplement and can be installed on {{case.aircraftFamilyPhrase}}, {{case.airworthinessPart}} aircraft.
STC__MULTIPLE.paragraph_2_basis: Approval is requested based on identicality to the approved design data of different STCs and is evidenced by the STC Authorizations under 14 CFR 21.303(a)(4).

formattingRules.rule: Model eligibility uses 'B' before Boeing models and 'A' before Airbus models; use the word 'Series' or 'Models' as the assist letter or STC does; add special notes or exceptions as applicable.
